CS ATAR offline library — 31 October 2026
2026 foundation, revised for 2027. Classroom draft; review continues.

Extract the complete ZIP before use. Open index.html in a modern browser. Keep folders together. No server or account is required for reading. If scripts are blocked by school policy, open offline/unit-1-reader.html (or Units 2–4) and use activity PDFs.

The four unit readers embed their diagrams and chapter text. They include public explained answers. Reader print buttons offer student/answer copies; use browser Save as PDF.

External links and official sources need internet. Python/Pygame and SQLite require suitable installed software. Local-file browser policies may limit progress storage. Downloads do not update automatically.

Original content CC BY 4.0, original code MIT; see licence.html and included licence files. All teacher/reference answers are public resources, not secure assessments.
